display_name: List every tracked MCP bridge subprocess (macOS plugin)
description: macOS implementation of list_bridges: read-only enumeration of the tracker's registry. Bound-provider skip semantics mean callers should route through service_interface::coding_agent_session_service::list_bridges instead of this plugin::* key.
embedding_description: macOS-side enumeration of tracked MCP bridge subprocesses — one row per agent_instance_id with pid + alive + started_at. Mirrors the canonical service_interface::coding_agent_session_service::list_bridges contract. Returns BridgeListResult.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: BridgeListResult frozen dataclass mirroring the canonical service interface return.
